campaigns.title: PEEP Turns Chrome and Edge Into Post-Compromise Backdoors for Host Command Execution
campaigns.summary: Des chercheurs en sécurité ont révélé des détails sur PEEP, un outil post-exploitation basé sur Chromium qui masque son installation comme une extension de favoris dans les navigateurs Chrome et Edge.

top_reads.summary: Online maths learning platform Mathspace disclosed over the weekend that attackers stole data from more than 1 million students, staff, and parents after breaching its Metabase internal reporting system. [...]
